title: Compound savings growth
prompt: A savings account starts with a balance of 1000.0 in year 0 and grows by 10% each year. Using a recursive CTE named growth(year, balance) where each recursive step computes balance as the previous balance multiplied by 1.10, compute the balance for years 0 through 5. Return year and balance.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dummy11 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO dummy11 VALUES (1);
reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE growth(year, balance) AS (SELECT 0, 1000.0 UNION ALL SELECT year + 1, balance * 1.10 FROM growth WHERE year < 5) SELECT year, balance FROM growth;
